title: attached CAdES now carries signingTime
result: `buildAttachedSignedData` signs `cadesSignedAttributes` (the PAdES set plus signingTime, OID 1.2.840.113549.1.9.5), as ETSI EN 319 122-1 CAdES-B-B requires and AutoFirma always does; PAdES keeps its set without it. Found reading AutoFirma's source; affects the `nic correo` signature.
evidence: `pnpm check:ci` green (1531 tests); a test-identity signature passes `openssl cms -verify -noverify` and `-cmsout -print` shows the signingTime UTCTime. Not yet re-run live against ES-NIC.
